hooks.command: in=$(cat); case "$in" in *git*commit*) printf '%s' "$in" | /usr/bin/python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/check-commit-message.py" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
agent-notify send --json --ignore-errors --source claude --cwd "$PWD" --event notification --title 'Claude needs attention' --dedupe-key claude-notification --dedupe-window-sec 60
agent-notify send --json --ignore-errors --source claude --cwd "$PWD" --event subagent_stop --title 'Claude subagent finished' --dedupe-window-sec 30
